## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated first (TDD)
- [ ] Integration testing was run when the change touches Tencent APIs, Docker, or deployment

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change has a focused scope and follows existing TypeScript patterns.
- [ ] Public behavior, configuration, and README/docs are updated where needed.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, tokens, local paths, generated `dist/` files, or runtime data are committed.
- [ ] Error handling and security implications were considered.
- [ ] Backward compatibility and migration impact were considered.
- [ ] New behavior has deterministic tests and external dependencies are isolated.

## Risk and rollback

Describe the risk, affected components, and how to roll back the change.
